dct_description_sm: There were 2 Focus Canada surveys conducted in 2015: "Survey on Immigration and Multiculturalism" and "Canadian Public Opinion on Climate Change". This dataset only refers to the "Survey on Immigration and Multiculturalism".

The Focus Canada National Survey is a national public opinion survey to take the pulse of Canadians on a wide range of relevant policy areas and issues facing the country at this time. As part of its ongoing Focus Canada public opinion research program, the Environics Institute asked Canadians about immigration and multiculturalism to update its ongoing research on these topics dating back to the 1970s.
